This page contains info for the Research Committee of the Duke **Statistical Science Majors Union** (SSMU). We run a seminar series
featuring researchers doing stats-related work in academia and industry. We also run an undergrad reading group on modern theory/methods
in statistics and ML. 

We are actively looking for undergrads to **join our committee**! You need not be a Stats major (I'm not). If interested, email me at
**xiran [dot] wang [at] duke [dot] edu**. There is a short application. 




## SSMU Seminars

We always welcome Duke faculty, postdocs, and PhD students from all departments to talk about their research!
We also welcome other student organizations to cosponsor these talks. Email me if you want to give or cosponsor a talk.

For the **2026-2027** school year, we plan to host **one** seminar in the Fall and **four** seminars in the Spring.

function createSeminarCard(seminar) {
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'seminar-card';
  card.innerHTML = `
    <div class="seminar-card-left">
      <h3 class="seminar-card-speaker">${seminar.speaker}</h3>
      <p class="seminar-card-affiliation">${seminar.affiliation}</p>
      <div class="seminar-card-meta">
        <strong>Date:</strong> ${seminar.date}<br>
        <strong>Time:</strong> ${seminar.time}<br>
        <strong>Location:</strong> ${seminar.location}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="seminar-card-center">
      <p class="seminar-card-subtitle">${seminar.subtitle}</p>
      <p class="seminar-card-description">${seminar.description}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="seminar-card-right">
      <img src="${seminar.headshot}" alt="${seminar.speaker}" class="seminar-card-headshot">
      <a href="${seminar.flyer}" class="seminar-card-flyer" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"> Event Flyer </a>
    </div>
  `;
  return card;
}

function initializeSeminars() {
  // Handle upcoming section
  const upcomingSection = document.getElementById('seminars-upcoming');
  if (upcomingSection && seminarsData.upcoming) {
    const grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'seminar-grid';
    seminarsData.upcoming.forEach(seminar => {
      grid.appendChild(createSeminarCard(seminar));
    });
    upcomingSection.appendChild(grid);
  }
  
  // Handle past semesters - dynamically create dropdowns
  const pastContainer = document.getElementById('seminars-past-container');
  if (pastContainer) {
    Object.entries(seminarsData).forEach(([sectionName, seminars]) => {
      if (sectionName !== 'upcoming' && seminars.length > 0) {
        const details = document.createElement('details');
        const summary = document.createElement('summary');
        summary.textContent = sectionName;
        details.appendChild(summary);
        
        const section = document.createElement('div');
        section.className = 'seminar-section';
        const grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'seminar-grid';
        seminars.forEach(seminar => {
          grid.appendChild(createSeminarCard(seminar));
        });
        section.appendChild(grid);
        details.appendChild(section);
        
        pastContainer.appendChild(details);
      }
    });
  }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeSeminars);
</script>

function createRecordingItem(recording) {
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'recording-item';
  
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="recording-speaker">${recording.speaker}</div>
    <div class="recording-date">${recording.date}</div>
    <a href="${recording.link}" class="recording-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${recording.linkText}</a>
  `;
  
  return el;
}

function initializeRecordings() {
  const pastContainer = document.getElementById('recordings-past-container');
  if (!pastContainer) return;
  
  Object.entries(recordingsData).forEach(([sectionName, recordings]) => {
    if (recordings.length > 0) {
      const details = document.createElement('details');
      const summary = document.createElement('summary');
      summary.textContent = sectionName;
      details.appendChild(summary);
      
      const section = document.createElement('div');
      section.className = 'recordings-section';
      const list = document.createElement('div');
      list.className = 'recordings-list';
      recordings.forEach(recording => {
        list.appendChild(createRecordingItem(recording));
      });
      section.appendChild(list);
      details.appendChild(section);
      
      pastContainer.appendChild(details);
    }
  });
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeRecordings);
</script>



## Reading Group
We meet roughly triweekly on **Fridays**, **5-6pm** in **Perkins Link Group Study 1**. At each meeting, someone presents on a manuscript/excerpt they read, and we discuss. 
If you're an undergrad interested in theory/methods in stats/ML, put your name [here](https://forms.gle/CjDY6RXVbAuidamb9), and show up! No prerequisites required.  

If you would like to present a manuscript, please email me. 
For the **2026-2027** school year, we will meet **four** times in the Fall and **four** times in the Spring.

function createRGItem(itemData, index) {
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'rg-item';
  el.tabIndex = 0;

  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="rg-summary" aria-hidden="false">
      <p class="rg-date">${itemData.date}</p>
      <p class="rg-manuscript">${itemData.manuscript}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="rg-details" id="rg-details-${index}">
      <div>
        <p class="rg-presenter"><strong>Presenter:</strong> ${itemData.presenter}</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <p class="rg-keywords"><strong>Keywords:</strong> <span>${(itemData.keywords||[]).join(', ')}</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    // avoid toggling when clicking inside links or selectable areas in future
    if (e.target.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'a') return;
    el.classList.toggle('rg-open');
  });

  el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      el.classList.toggle('rg-open');
    }
  });

  return el;
}


function initializeReadingGroup() {
  // Handle upcoming section
  const upcomingSection = document.getElementById('reading-group-upcoming');
  if (upcomingSection && readingGroupData.upcoming) {
    const list = document.createElement('div');
    list.className = 'rg-list';
    readingGroupData.upcoming.forEach((item, idx) => {
      list.appendChild(createRGItem(item, idx));
    });
    upcomingSection.appendChild(list);
  }
  
  // Handle past semesters - dynamically create dropdowns
  const pastContainer = document.getElementById('reading-group-past-container');
  if (pastContainer) {
    Object.entries(readingGroupData).forEach(([sectionName, items]) => {
      if (sectionName !== 'upcoming' && items.length > 0) {
        const details = document.createElement('details');
        const summary = document.createElement('summary');
        summary.textContent = sectionName;
        details.appendChild(summary);
        
        const section = document.createElement('div');
        section.className = 'rg-section';
        const list = document.createElement('div');
        list.className = 'rg-list';
        items.forEach((item, idx) => {
          list.appendChild(createRGItem(item, idx));
        });
        section.appendChild(list);
        details.appendChild(section);
        
        pastContainer.appendChild(details);
      }
    });
  }
}

function createRecItem(itemData, index) {
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'rec-item';
  el.tabIndex = 0;

  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="rec-summary">
      <p class="rec-manuscript">${itemData.manuscript}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="rec-details" id="rec-details-${index}">
      <div>
        <p class="rec-keywords"><strong>Keywords:</strong> <span>${(itemData.keywords||[]).join(', ')}</span></p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <p class="rec-prerequisite"><strong>Recommended prerequisite:</strong> ${itemData.prerequisite}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    // avoid toggling when clicking inside links or selectable areas in future
    if (e.target.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'a') return;
    el.classList.toggle('rec-open');
  });

  el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      el.classList.toggle('rec-open');
    }
  });

  return el;
}

function initializeRecommended() {
  const section = document.getElementById('reading-group-recommended');
  if (!section) return;
  const list = document.createElement('div');
  list.className = 'rec-list';
  recommendedData.forEach((item, idx) => {
    list.appendChild(createRecItem(item, idx));
  });
  section.appendChild(list);
}


document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeReadingGroup);
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeRecommended);
</script>
